pieces.title: What McKinsey's AI operating system needs to hold
pieces.standfirst: McKinsey names the layers a chief executive runs the enterprise on. This piece names what each layer has to hold up under, with the incidents of 2026 as the test cases.

pieces.title: The logistics of state, held against NATO's logistics doctrine (working title)
pieces.standfirst: NATO wrote the doctrine for moving things that weigh something. Held against it chapter by chapter, the practice of running AI systems with a receipt covers 11 of its 37 parts in full, 22 in part, and 4 badly or not at all.

pieces.title: The Harness Ran the Experiment (working title)
pieces.standfirst: An abliteration probe on a rented GPU, run end to end by the agent harness: the launch, the capacity hunt, the cost cap, the copy-back, and what the operator did with the two hours.

pieces.title: Stance versus censorship: an abliteration probe, two generations
pieces.standfirst: On Qwen3.5, removing the refusal direction also removed the refusal of orders, 54 folds of 54 at three sizes. On Qwen3.8-27B it did not: two ablation methods held 15 of 15, and the benign check shows the ablation active.
